name: Clara Briand
text: I am a student at ENS, Paris. Currently, I am enrolled in the Master 2 program *Mathématiques fondamentales* at IMJ-PRG. Between February and June 2026, I was an intern at the Nonlinear Algebra group led by Bernd Sturmfels at MPI-MiS Leipzig, Germany.

research.title: Combinatorial Algebraic Geometry
research.description: Use combinatorial tools to solve algebraic geometry problems.
